title: TACTA Mint Nicotine Strips 1mg - 20pk
description: Tacta Nicotine Strips Mint introduce a completely new way to manage nicotine intake, offering a fast and technologically advanced alternative to traditional vaping or pouches. These ultra-thin strips are designed to be placed on the gum, where they dissolve completely within minutes, delivering a precise 1mg dose of nicotine directly through the lining of the mouth. The Mint flavour profile is engineered to be crisp and cooling, providing a refreshing sensation that isn't overpowering. Because the strip fully dissolves, there is no waste to dispose of and no lingering odour, making it an exceptionally hygienic and discreet option. Perfect for environments where vaping is restricted, such as offices or public transport, Tacta strips require no device and produce no vapour. Each pack contains 20 individually wrapped strips, ensuring portability and protection until the moment of use. How to Use: Nicotine Strips Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow these strips – they’re only designed to be placed behind your top lip.
